items.title: Recover embedded Chat automatically
items.detail: Tuner now checks embedded Chat after a navigation or connection failure and tries to restore it if it stays unavailable. When you return to Tuner, it waits before checking so a slow page has time to load.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: Compatible with Tightbeam CLI 0.1.16 and Gateway 0.1.16 (build 4283), plus Chat v0.1.100, for the tested paths: the CLI roster returned the required fields, and Tuner opened a conversation, sent one prompt, and showed the reply. Tuner's in-app SSH roster fetch was not exercised.
